sections.heading: Transcript
sections.text:
Moreman: I hope this comes through. I don't know if we'll make it, so I'm leaving this recording.

Moreman: When we were getting to the fallback point, Yastreb totally fucking snapped and started shooting at us! We put him down fast, but we walked into an ambush: shitheads came at us from every direction. Fuck. Guess the shooting… the shooting was… was a signal, damn it. Fuck. Motherfucking traitor…

Moreman: We're still operational, but we got hit hard. Requesting help. Listen guys, I don't hold it against-
